description: This file contains SwiftUI view extensions for 'ChannelsSettings', adding UI components and helper functions related to channel management, including login handling for WhatsApp and Telegram, as well as configuration sections.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: An extension providing SwiftUI view components and helper functions for managing channel settings within the application.

methods.name: formSection
methods.description: Creates a styled form section with a title and custom content.

methods.name: channelHeaderActions
methods.description: Provides header actions (logout, refresh) for a given channel.

methods.name: whatsAppSection
methods.description: Constructs the UI section related to WhatsApp linking and login controls.

methods.name: genericChannelSection
methods.description: Builds a configuration section for a specified channel.

methods.name: configEditorSection
methods.description: Creates configuration editing controls, including save and reload actions for a channel.

methods.name: configStatusMessage
methods.description: Displays the current configuration status message if available.
